biggest_catch: Very long day: 6 AM to about 9:30 PM plus a 2.5-hour training class for a $135 flat stipend.
catches: Work on election day from 6 a.m. until all duties are complete, approximately 9:30 p.m.
Attend a 2 1/2 hour mandatory training class, per election.
Must be 18+, U.S. citizen and registered voter in California or a lawful permanent resident (or qualifying high school student).
Standard stipend may not apply to all programs and is subject to change.

Work Election Day 6:00 AM until all duties complete (~9:30 PM).
